question: Users say the page feels slow to appear. What's the problem?
options: Suspense can't be used at the root
Streaming is turned off by this boundary
The shell is only a spinner, with no real layout
say: Users say the page feels slow to appear. What's the problem?
explanation: With one boundary around the whole app, the shell is just the spinner. A big spinner feels slower than a real layout. Place boundaries so the shell is minimal but complete.
explainSay: The whole app is in one boundary, so the shell is just a spinner. Make the shell a skeleton of the real layout.
